title: MAPLE: A Multi-Axis Parametric Knowledge Extraction Lens for LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19827v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs absorb vast knowledge from training data, yet their inherently probabilistic nature offers no guarantee that this knowledge will surface in their outputs. To bridge this gap, Knowledge Extraction Enhancement (KEE) techniques such as activation steering, decoding adjustments, and prompting modify inference, potentially reinforcing existing predictions or surfacing less accessible answers. Yet their evaluations centered on aggregate accuracy, which obscures diverse effects by collapsing recovered failures and disrupted successes into a single score. We introduce MAPLE, a unified framework for characterizing how KEE techniques affect parametric knowledge extraction. Its diagnostic metrics disentangle these effects at the surface, probability, and beyond-sampling levels by measuring answer recovery and disruption, gold-token rank shifts on unrecovered failures, and recovery of answers missed by fixed-budget sampling. translated_title: MAPLE：用于大语言模型评估的多轴参数化知识提取透镜
translated_abstract: 大语言模型从训练数据中吸收海量知识，但其固有的概率性本质无法保证这些知识会在其输出中显现。为弥合这一差距，知识提取增强（KEE）技术——如激活引导、解码调整和提示——通过修改推理过程，可能强化已有的预测，或挖掘出较难获取的答案。然而，现有评估以总体准确率为中心，将“成功恢复的失败案例”与“被干扰的成功案例”合并为单一分数，从而掩盖了这些技术多样化的影响。我们提出MAPLE，一个用于刻画KEE技术如何影响参数化知识提取的统一框架。其诊断指标通过测量答案的恢复与干扰、未恢复失败案例中正确词元的排名变化，以及固定预算采样所遗漏答案的恢复情况，在表层、概率和超越采样三个层面解耦上述影响。我们评估了六种KEE……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MAPLE统一评估框架，通过在表层、概率和超越采样三个层面测量答案恢复与干扰、正确词元排名变化及采样遗漏答案的恢复情况，全面解耦知识提取增强（KEE）技术对大语言模型参数化知识提取的多样化影响。
